$comment: Non-negotiable positioning. The agent rejects topics that do not map to this ICP.
primaryAudience: US-based service businesses and B2B companies
founders, operators, revenue leaders and marketing leaders
teams evaluating AI agents, workflow automation, internal operations, lead response, support and revenue systems

positioning.summary: Practical AI automation for businesses that need reliable execution, not AI demos.

rejectTopics: content aimed primarily at other agencies
disconnected personal stories with no buyer relevance

growthTarget.note: A target to work toward by 31 December 2026, never a promise. Posting supplies the content; the reach lever on a small account is the operator's own daily commenting on ICP posts, which this system deliberately does not automate. Pacing is reported as ahead / on track / behind against real follower samples.
